risks.reasoning: Using the latest audited comparable annual period (year ended 31 December 2020), cash and cash equivalents were RMB1,034,965 thousand and net cash used in operating activities was RMB403,716 thousand. Preserving the signed operating cash flow input as -403,716, monthly operating cash burn is RMB33,643 thousand and cash runway is approximately 30.76 months, which is not below the frozen <12-month medium threshold.

The accountants' report shows losses for both comparable audited annual periods in the Track Record Period: RMB521,028 thousand for 2019 and RMB1,283,510 thousand for 2020. Two comparable loss periods meet the frozen medium criterion. The prospectus states that the accountants' report covers only these two financial years under Chapter 18A.

The Business section explicitly describes the Group as a pre-revenue company, and the accountants' report shows that the income recorded in 2019 and 2020 was bank interest and government grants rather than revenue. Revenue is therefore normalized to zero for both comparable annual periods. The frozen year-on-year revenue-growth formula has a zero prior-period denominator, so a growth percentage cannot be calculated without inventing a policy. POLICY_AMBIGUITY: Protocol v1.1.1 does not freeze a label for zero-to-zero revenue growth.

The prospectus states that the Group is a pre-revenue company and that no product revenue was generated during the Track Record Period because all products remained under development. Customer revenue concentration therefore has a zero/undefined revenue denominator. Under Protocol v1.1.1 this is OPEN-01 and must be reported rather than resolved.

calculation_inputs.period: Track Record Period: years ended 31 December 2019 and 2020

risks.reasoning: For the year ended 31 December 2020, the formal Business supplier table discloses RMB564,131 thousand of purchases from the largest supplier. The audited statement records R&D expenses of RMB875,795 thousand and administrative expenses of RMB103,396 thousand, giving the formally disclosed denominator basis of RMB979,191 thousand. The largest supplier ratio is approximately 57.61%, meeting the frozen >=50% high threshold. The top-five ratio is approximately 76.39%, below the >=80% high top-five threshold, but the largest-supplier test independently triggers high.

The Pre-IPO Investment disclosure states that preferred shareholders had redemption rights; those rights terminate immediately before the first listing application but automatically restore if listing is not completed within nine months after that application. This is an expressly restorable special right. Under the frozen policy, actual effective/restorable special rights require review and the candidate severity remains provisional medium/50.

The formal Business disclosures state that, during the Track Record Period through the relevant date, the Group was not involved in legal proceedings that would individually or collectively have a material adverse effect, had no non-compliance event believed to cause material operational or financial impact, and had obtained all necessary material licences, permits, approvals and certificates, with no government penalty for non-compliance relating to their retention or renewal. No material pending matter or unresolved regulatory/licence effect is established.

The Business section states that the Group is a pre-revenue company, that candidate drugs are generally not expected to be sold or commercialized in the short term, and that commercialization of the core product BRII-179 remains subject to development work and required regulatory approvals. The factual candidate is therefore present, but Protocol v1.1.1 leaves precommercial_product severity open. POLICY_AMBIGUITY: OPEN-02.
